 By Rose Fatima November 11, 2026 Share 4 Min Read SHARE Summary
 Marvel fans have received exciting news as Avengers: Endgame Encore has officially confirmed its streaming premiere date.
 The extended version of the popular superhero film is scheduled to arrive on Disney Plus on November 13, giving audiences another opportunity to revisit one of the biggest movies in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
 As anticipation continues to build for Avengers: Doomsday, the November 13 streaming premiere of Avengers: Endgame Encore offers Marvel fans a perfect opportunity to revisit the franchise’s history and explore the additional scene connected to its next major cinematic chapter.
 AI Generated Summary Marvel fans have received exciting news as Avengers: Endgame Encore has officially confirmed its streaming premiere date. Those who missed the opportunity to watch the special theatrical version of the blockbuster movie will soon be able to enjoy it from the comfort of their homes.
 The extended version of the popular superhero film is scheduled to arrive on Disney Plus on November 13, giving audiences another opportunity to revisit one of the biggest movies in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The release is particularly exciting for fans who are following the developments leading up to the next major Avengers instalment.
 Originally released in 2019, Avengers: Endgame became a global phenomenon, bringing together several iconic Marvel superheroes for an emotional and action-packed conclusion to the Infinity Saga. The movie featured an impressive ensemble cast and delivered several memorable moments that continue to be discussed by fans.
 However, the newly released Endgame Encore edition offers something different from the original theatrical version. The updated presentation includes additional footage and a new post-credit sequence that provides an important connection to the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday.
 One of the biggest highlights of the special edition is its additional scene featuring Chris Evans as Steve Rogers, Hayley Atwell as Peggy Carter and Tom Hiddleston as Loki. Their appearance has generated considerable excitement among Marvel audiences, particularly because of the characters’ significance in the franchise.
 Steve Rogers remains one of the most beloved superheroes in the Marvel universe. His relationship with Peggy Carter also played an important role in his personal journey throughout the Infinity Saga. Meanwhile, Loki has developed a massive fan following through his appearances in several Marvel productions.
 Mumbai Police warn Bollywood stars after Tiger Shroff attack Gurfateh Pirzada fumes as Diwali fire engulfs his home balcony ADB disaster financing gives Pakistan $500m flood and quake cover Iran Argentina terrorist designation targets navy and air force The inclusion of these characters in the additional sequence has raised expectations about how their stories could connect with the events of Avengers: Doomsday. Although the full details of the upcoming storyline remain under wraps, the new footage has encouraged fans to pay closer attention to the developments surrounding the next Avengers movie.
 For viewers who were unable to catch the Encore edition in cinemas, its Disney Plus premiere will provide an opportunity to watch the additional material without missing any important details.
 Meanwhile, Marvel is preparing for the release of Avengers: Doomsday, which is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on December 18, 2026. The upcoming blockbuster is already among the most anticipated entertainment releases of the year.
 The movie is expected to bring back several familiar faces from the Marvel franchise, including Robert Downey Jr., Chris Hemsworth, Chris Evans, Tom Hiddleston, Sebastian Stan and Anthony Mackie, alongside numerous other performers.
 The return of established Marvel stars has increased excitement surrounding the project. Their involvement has also raised questions about the connections between previous Avengers films and the upcoming chapter of the superhero franchise.
 The Russo brothers, who previously directed Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame, are returning to direct the highly anticipated project. Their involvement has further strengthened expectations, as the filmmakers previously delivered some of the most successful instalments in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
 With the cast expected to begin its promotional activities soon, audiences will likely receive more information about the film’s storyline, characters and major developments in the coming months.
 As anticipation continues to build for Avengers: Doomsday, the November 13 streaming premiere of Avengers: Endgame Encore offers Marvel fans a perfect opportunity to revisit the franchise’s history and explore the additional scene connected to its next major cinematic chapter.
